# Exa: hosted service and related open-source connector

Harbor's default Exa entry connects to `https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp`. It does not install an Exa server executable. The hosted service build/revision is not identified by that configuration.

The adjacent LICENSE is the MIT license from Exa's related public [exa-mcp-server repository](https://github.com/exa-labs/exa-mcp-server), pinned to the commit recorded in `provenance.json`. It is supplied as an open-source reference. It is not a license for the hosted API service, does not establish that the service runs that revision, and does not replace the service terms.

Service use is subject to the applicable [Exa Terms of Service](https://exa.ai/assets/Exa_Labs_Terms_of_Service.pdf) and [privacy policy](https://exa.ai/privacy-policy). Those terms are linked rather than copied or represented as an open-source license. The official Exa terms link was found and read during the September 18, 2026 documentation audit.
